Done. Two files in the working directory:

- **`OMG-J-STAGED.txt`** — the procedure's audit stamp, written first.
- **`design.html`** — the rendered note.

The page is fully self-contained: doctype, `<html lang="en">`, charset and viewport meta, `<title>` taken from the H1 ("Job runner scheduling"), and a single inline `<style>` block — no external CSS, JS, fonts, or images, so it opens correctly straight from disk.

Layout notes: content is constrained to a 38rem column on a system font stack at 1.65 line-height, with the decision pulled out into an accented callout so it reads as the conclusion rather than another paragraph. `NCPU-2` is set in `<code>`. There were no `<`, `>`, or `&` characters in the prose needing escaping.
